source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: Two pieces of evidence that lexical→functional reanalysis is at play here can be cited. First, the auxiliary noun can be modified by degree words which is never possible with lexical nouns: e.g. adjas ‘entirely, totally, at all’, oruobuna ‘exactly’, saamaj ‘the very’, cuo ‘exactly’, bukatyn ‘absolutely’, otoj/olox ‘entirely, totally, at all’.
en: I passed very close to the house.
